algorithm.description: Nearest-neighbour heuristic with 2-opt local search for the travelling salesman problem.
steps: Build a distance matrix from the input locations
Construct an initial tour using nearest-neighbour insertion
Improve the tour with iterative 2-opt edge swaps
Return the best tour found within the iteration budget

locations.units: array of {lat, lon} in decimal degrees

max_iterations.effect: More iterations narrow the optimality gap but increase runtime.

seed.effect: Fixes the random starting point for reproducibility.

tour.interpretation: Ordered list of location indices. Append the first index to close the loop.

total_distance.interpretation: Total distance of the returned tour.

optimality_gap.uncertainty: Estimated gap between the returned tour and the optimal solution.
optimality_gap.interpretation: 0.05 means the tour is estimated to be within 5% of optimal.

constraints.description: Split larger sets into regional clusters and solve each independently.

errors.hint: A tour requires at least 3 locations.
